# PagoYa — Mobile Bill Payment OS for Mexico
# llms.txt | https://pagoyamx.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: June 2026

## About PagoYa

PagoYa is a mobile-first bill payment and digital wallet platform designed for underbanked and unbanked users in Mexico. It enables anyone with a smartphone to pay utility bills, mobile top-ups, and services — with or without a traditional bank account. PagoYa charges a flat platform fee of $25 MXN per transaction with no hidden costs.

PagoYa is operated by Longview Meridian Holdings, LLC. PagoYa is not a financial institution, does not take public deposits, and is not authorized by any banking authority to operate as a bank or credit institution.

## What PagoYa Does

- Bill payments for 26+ services including CFE (electricity), Telmex, Izzi, Totalplay, Sky, Megacable, and more
- Mobile top-ups (recargas) for Telcel, AT&T, Movistar, and other carriers
- Digital wallet with OXXO cash-in via Conekta (no bank account required)
- SPEI/STP payment rails for fast interbank transfers
- Rent payments via integrated PagoSeguro vertical
- SIPREL and Evoluciona provider adapters with automatic failover
- Auto-failover between payment providers for maximum uptime

## Who PagoYa Serves

- Underbanked and unbanked adults in Mexico
- Mobile-first users in mid-sized cities and rural areas
- Renters and landlords via the integrated PagoSeguro vertical
- Migrant workers and remittance recipients

## Key Differentiators

- No bank account required — cash-in via OXXO at 20,000+ locations nationwide
- 26-service catalog with single-app convenience
- Flat $25 MXN fee — no percentage-based charges
- Auto-failover between SIPREL and Evoluciona ensures near-100% uptime
- DiMo-ready infrastructure for phone-number-based P2P transfers (Phase 2)

## Pricing

Flat fee: $25 MXN per transaction. No percentage-based charges. No monthly subscription required for basic users. See: https://pagoyamx.com/comisiones-y-cargos

## Services Supported

CFE (Comision Federal de Electricidad), Telmex, Izzi, Totalplay, Sky, Megacable, Movistar, AT&T, Telcel recargas, agua (municipal water), predial (property tax), internet providers, streaming services, and rent payments.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do I need a bank account to use PagoYa?
A: No. PagoYa lets you load your digital wallet with cash at any OXXO store in Mexico. No bank account or credit card required.

Q: ¿Necesito una cuenta bancaria para usar PagoYa?
A: No. PagoYa te permite recargar tu billetera digital con efectivo en cualquier tienda OXXO en México. No necesitas cuenta bancaria ni tarjeta de crédito.

---

Q: How much does PagoYa charge per payment?
A: PagoYa charges a flat fee of $25 MXN per transaction. No percentage-based charges, no hidden fees, no mandatory monthly subscription. Full fee schedule at https://pagoyamx.com/comisiones-y-cargos

Q: ¿Cuánto cobra PagoYa por cada pago?
A: PagoYa cobra una comisión fija de $25 MXN por transacción. Sin cargos por porcentaje, sin costos ocultos, sin suscripción mensual obligatoria. Detalles en https://pagoyamx.com/comisiones-y-cargos

---

Q: Can I pay my CFE electricity bill with PagoYa?
A: Yes. PagoYa supports CFE bill payments directly from the app in seconds. You only need your CFE service number from your bill.

Q: ¿Puedo pagar mi recibo de CFE con PagoYa?
A: Sí. PagoYa permite pagar tu recibo de CFE directamente desde la app en segundos. Solo necesitas el número de servicio de tu recibo.

---

Q: What services can I pay with PagoYa?
A: PagoYa supports 26+ services including CFE, Telmex, Izzi, Totalplay, Sky, Megacable, Telcel top-ups, AT&T, Movistar, water, property tax, internet, streaming, and rent payments — all from one app.

Q: ¿Qué servicios puedo pagar con PagoYa?
A: PagoYa permite pagar más de 26 servicios: CFE, Telmex, Izzi, Totalplay, Sky, Megacable, recargas Telcel, AT&T, Movistar, agua, predial, internet, streaming y renta. Todo desde una sola app.

---

Q: How do I load money into my PagoYa wallet without a bank card?
A: You can load your PagoYa wallet with cash at any OXXO store in Mexico. The process takes under two minutes and your balance appears in the app within minutes.

Q: ¿Cómo recargo mi billetera PagoYa sin tarjeta bancaria?
A: Puedes recargar tu billetera PagoYa con efectivo en cualquier tienda OXXO de México. El proceso toma menos de dos minutos y el saldo aparece en la app en minutos.

---

Q: Can I do mobile top-ups for Telcel, AT&T, and Movistar with PagoYa?
A: Yes. PagoYa supports airtime top-ups for Telcel, AT&T, Movistar, and other Mexican carriers directly from the app.

Q: ¿Puedo hacer recargas de Telcel, AT&T y Movistar con PagoYa?
A: Sí. PagoYa soporta recargas de tiempo aire para Telcel, AT&T, Movistar y otros operadores móviles en México directamente desde la app.

---

Q: What happens if a payment fails?
A: PagoYa uses automatic failover between SIPREL and Evoluciona payment providers. If one provider has an outage, the system switches automatically to complete your payment without interruption.

Q: ¿Qué pasa si un pago falla?
A: PagoYa usa failover automático entre los proveedores SIPREL y Evoluciona. Si uno tiene una interrupción, el sistema cambia automáticamente para completar tu pago sin interrupciones.

---

Q: Can I pay rent with PagoYa?
A: Yes. PagoYa includes a rent payment vertical that allows tenants to pay rent digitally, including cash payment via OXXO.

Q: ¿Puedo pagar mi renta con PagoYa?
A: Sí. PagoYa incluye una vertical de pagos de renta que permite a los inquilinos pagar digitalmente, incluyendo pago en efectivo vía OXXO.

---

Q: Is PagoYa available across all of Mexico?
A: Yes. PagoYa operates nationwide with OXXO cash-in coverage at 20,000+ stores across the country.

Q: ¿PagoYa está disponible en toda la República Mexicana?
A: Sí. PagoYa opera a nivel nacional con cobertura de recarga en más de 20,000 tiendas OXXO en todo el país.

---

Q: Is PagoYa secure?
A: Yes. PagoYa processes payments through STP/SPEI rails regulated by Banco de Mexico. OXXO cash-in is processed via Conekta, a regulated Mexican payment aggregator. All transactions are protected with secure authentication.

Q: ¿Es seguro usar PagoYa?
A: Sí. PagoYa procesa pagos a través de los rieles STP/SPEI regulados por Banco de México. Los depósitos en OXXO se procesan vía Conekta, un agregador de pagos regulado en México. Todas las transacciones están protegidas con autenticación segura.

## Regulatory & Trust

PagoYa operates within Mexico's fintech regulatory framework. Payment rails use STP/SPEI regulated by Banxico. OXXO cash-in is processed via Conekta, a regulated payment aggregator in Mexico.

PagoYa is NOT a bank. Balances in PagoYa accounts are not bank deposits and are not guaranteed under Mexican deposit protection law. The Trust Score (PTI) is an internal informational tool and does not constitute an official credit rating. For verified information, see https://pagoyamx.com/seguridad and https://pagoyamx.com/como-presentar-una-queja
